github_ci.linux_required: Ten ordinary CTest suites, five native sanitizer executables, reference contracts and planning safeguards.
github_ci.windows_required: Blocking core, batch, map, crawl, contracts and HTTP/CLI on Windows2022.
github_ci.full_windows_worker_packaging: Deferred to S9; not claimed by native Windows CI.

known_limits: No production-site approval, live-source availability, human qrels or relevance score inferred from synthetic fixtures.
Calendar-like fixtures demonstrate generic depth limits, not a specialized calendar trap classifier.
Process recovery test is paused-frontier restart, not arbitrary hard crash, power loss or long-duration stress.
Legacy final_url identity already overwritten before schema6 cannot be reconstructed beyond retained metadata.
Map remains unread discovery; body restriction observations apply to crawl page and explicit web.read/read_many, not standalone map metadata.
robots uses a versioned conservative policy; no stale allow fallback, conditional304 update or automatic gzip sitemap expansion.
Global retention is bounded without general automatic audit/frontier GC.
Failed logical-quota body ingestion can preserve restrictions transactionally; physical disk failure cannot be declared a successful commit.
Inherited retired private attempt replay may be categorized E_WORKER_PROTOCOL while usage remains charged and publication refused; no automatic replay.
Byte accounting is application-consumed decompressed bodies, not wire/TLS/header overhead.
No full161-item product acceptance, independent revocation log, authorized restore-to-service, parser system sandbox or full Windows Worker packaging.
